Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Dunbar Modern Wood Buffet, 55"W, Oak
Colors: Buffet
Materials: Wood
55"W x 19"D x 36"H Hardwood top A simple modern piece with rustic and modern influences Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This handsome modern buffet provides function with style - and is perfect for storing wine, linens, and glassware. Simple, clean lines and beautiful quarter-sawn oak veneer finish make this piece look at home in rustic or modern settings. Assembly is required. Wipe with soft dry cloth.
